t: Magnusson folding work platform with lightweight aluminium construction, weighing just 3.9kg. Compact design folds down to fit easily into car and van boots, making it ideal for trade professionals needing portable access solutions. The wide, deep anti-slip platform surface provides secure footing whilst heavy-duty pin hinges and non-slip feet ensure stability on site. Supporting a 150kg static vertical load, this platform combines durability with convenience for everyday working tasks.
